stories.typical_0076: Daniel found a used truck that he thought was very cheap. He looked it over and even took it for a test drive. He was impressed with the low miles. After buying the truck, he found out how many problems it really had. He ended up spending more to fix it than he did to buy it.
stories.typical_0077: Mack was a large black lab puppy. He slept in bed with me every night, but his gas was terrible. One night, his gas was so atrocious that I moved to the couch to sleep. I could smell it all the way into the living room. Eventually he joined me on the couch.
stories.typical_0078: Tim was home alone. His neighbor went over and tried to walk in. Tim wasn't expecting anybody. The door was locked and the neighbor knocked. Tim never got up to answer.
stories.typical_0079: Tom needed glasses to see. His eyes were too sensitive for contact lenses. One day he broke his glasses. He didn't have a spare on him. He remained mostly blind all day.
stories.typical_0080: My mother bought me a toy robot once. I played with it everyday. One day it broke. I was sad and I told my mom. She calmed me down and bought me another robot.
stories.typical_0081: Jane went to the lake with her sister. They took a boat out to the middle. Jane was too excited and lost her paddle. Her sister paddling alone only made them go in circles. Jane had to help paddle with her hands.
stories.typical_0082: Richard was accused of assaulting a woman. He denied it. He took a polygraph test. He passed with flying colors. The charges were soon dropped.
stories.typical_0083: When i was in college,i learned how to bake. I started in baking those easy pastries. Then i decided to try baking cakes. When i have time, i'm baking in our house for my siblings. Then i became baker of the house.
stories.typical_0084: Billy was going crabbing with his dad. His dad was very good at crabbing. They got to the dock and put out their bait. They waited a while then began catching them. Billy and his dad caught many that day and were very happy.
stories.typical_0085: May and Tim packed the car with camping equipment. They were going up the canyon with their family for three days. They played games to pass the time on the long car ride. By early afternoon, they were in the canyon admiring the fall colors. Unpacking the car was first priority upon arriving at the campsite.
stories.typical_0086: Jeff saw an ad online for custom made furniture. He emailed the company and described to them what he wanted. Within two hours the company emailed him back. He was told that the man who made the furniture had passed away. Jeff was disappointed but he found some stuff at Ikea.
stories.typical_0087: Our company had carpenters restoring a section of the warehouse. They hired a carpenter and his assistant. On Thursday the two got into an argument. The carpenter punched his assistant, who called the police. Our company canceled the contract and hired another carpenter.
stories.typical_0088: Brad was a quick learner at the school of music in his city. He was the ideal student to have and many of his teachers agreed. He was a fast learner and could play any instrument they had. He became the next Beethoven and went on to write many composure. He was a genius composer and owed his success to his school of music.
stories.typical_0089: Leeroy stole Maddie's pencil when she wasn't looking. When Maddie returned, he told her he didn't know where it was. Maddie looked around everywhere for it. Leeroy felt terrible for denying having taken it. When Maddie wasn't looking, Leeroy put it back.
stories.typical_0090: I took my son to therapy. He was terrified of the stairs because of no depth perception. It took a very long time to get him up a few steps. By the end of the month, he was walking up stairs with weights. I was very proud of his accomplishments.
stories.typical_0091: Carlo wanted to go to the circus. The circus announced a new attraction. It was about a real live unicorn. When Carlo got there he was very excited. The unicorn was a goat with a single horn.
stories.typical_0092: Sophia was asleep in bed. Suddenly, the shrill cry of her baby woke her up. She tried changing him, offering him some milk and even cuddling. Still, nothing could calm the baby's crying. He cried on and on for hours, until finally giving Sophia a break.
stories.typical_0093: Jill went to the doctor for a routine check up. What they found was devastating. They told Jill it was Cancer. Jill was in complete shock over the news. Jill vowed to beat this sickness and overcome it all.
stories.typical_0094: John had his day off. John wanted to go to the beach. He got on his car and drove to the beach. John swam in the water. John had a good day.
stories.typical_0095: Sally was feeling lonely. She had moved away from home and was missing her friends. She heard a soft knock on the door. She opened the front door and saw all her friends standing there! She was so excited she cried!
stories.typical_0096: A button fell off of the man's pants. He tried to sew it back on. The button kept falling off. He asked his mom for help. His mom fixed his pants.
stories.typical_0097: Both cars lined up on the starting line. The flag waver looked at booth drivers. They were both ready and he counted down. 3, 2, 1, go! The cars were off, flying down the track.
stories.typical_0098: Sam built a cabin with materials from the land. He was very proud of what he'd done. Sam called everyone to show off his adroitness. The county building inspector told him his cabin wasn't to code. Sam was informed he needed to tear it down.
stories.typical_0099: I walked into my room. My wife was watching a workout DVD. She was doing squats along with it. I asked her if I could join her. We did many squats together.
